title: Her mother's first husband Mose Winn and the names Winn and Burley
summary: Her mother's first husband was Mose Winn; Mary Lou used Winn and Burley interchangeably as a girl.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Another thing, back in Atlanta, your mother married. Was she married before you were born or after?
She was married - I think she had left him shortly after I was born, when I was born, I'm sure, because I never met him. I only saw a picture of him.
When you were younger were you Mary Lou Winn for a while?
I used Winn and I used Burley for the last name. I was Mary Louise Winn and I used Burley.
